text_block_list.text:
Today was the day of the flea market 
sponsored by Tracen Academy. Having been 
roped into helping out, closing time was 
just around the corner when――

――Pyonnu Pierre-san, Motchiro, Kumanomori 
Michio-kun, Nyakonyakonosuke...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And Wafumofu Tamasaburo... Thank you all 
for your hard work up until now.

Aston Machan was talking to the mascots on 
the table for some reason.
choice_data_list: ...What are you doing?
...What are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Offering my appreciation and saying 
goodbye. The ones who couldn't find a new 
home are going to the sea――somewhere far 
away.
choice_data_list: The sea?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The sea is where things that have 
fulfilled their purpose eventually end up.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Tamasaburo and the others were once 
beloved figures in living rooms across the 
nation, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
None of the customers who came today 
seemed to remember that.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hence, today is goodbye for these little 
ones――or so the committee member told me 
earlier.

The bazaar committee probably designated 
items with 'no prospect of selling' for 
disposal, which must be what she meant...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And so, I am holding a farewell party. 
Etching them into Machan's memory.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It's alright, Machan won't forget.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So even if they go to the sea, it's not 
sad.
choice_data_list: It's too early to give up!
You look pretty sad, though...
You look pretty sad, though...
That's a very kind way to say goodbye.
That's a very kind way to say goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So even if they go to the sea, it's not 
sad.
choice_data_list: It's too early to give up!
You look pretty sad, though...
You look pretty sad, though...
That's a very kind way to say goodbye.
That's a very kind way to say goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Eh?

I told her that bazaar sales depend on 
ingenuity, and if we try everything we 
can, there's still a chance they might 
sell at the next one.
choice_data_list:
What kind of mascot do you think would 
sell?

What kind of mascot do you think would 
sell?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That would be... Ones that have a story, a 
narrative.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A story is an all-purpose seasoning that 
adds value to things...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That's why Machan runs, to etch the Machan 
story.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And to turn the Machan plushie into an 
ultra super mascot――ah.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ――I see. That's what I should do.
choice_data_list: Did you come up with a good idea?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. For Tamasaburo and friends, whose 
flavor people have forgotten――

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Machan just needs to sprinkle some spice 
over them.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's decided, it's time to go 
make a direct appeal to the committee. 
Well then, farewell for now.

Her face was full of life as she dashed 
off――

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Machan doesn't really think going to the 
sea is sad.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's something that inevitably comes, and 
it just happened to be now. That is all.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
――What's truly lonely is having even the 
fact that you went to the sea forgotten.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So Machan, at least, will remember like 
this. Forever.
choice_data_list: No, there's still more we can do.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Mumu? ...Meaning?
choice_data_list: Why don't we try just a little harder?

text_block_list.text:
I told her that bazaar sales depend on 
ingenuity, and if we try everything we 
can, there's still a chance they might 
sell at the next one.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Try everything we can... so Tamasaburo and 
the others won't be forgotten――

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. 'Remembering activities', or 
'Remem-act' for short, is something Machan 
does all the time, so I'm fairly good at 
it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If we try the same Remem-act techniques on 
Tamasaburo and the others as Machan does, 
perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
――There might be a chance. Let's go 
discuss this with the committee.

Aston Machan seemed to have come up with a 
'Remem-act' method for the mascots.

It is the way of the world for things to 
eventually be thrown away. Watching her 
try to send them off with all her heart 
felt both wistful and heartwarming.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Machan has resolved that farewells 
must be done with one hundred percent 
sincerity.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Right, since this is a farewell party. 
Let's take a commemorative memory photo.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
With the Machan plushie included, like a 
group photo.
choice_data_list:
I'll press the shutter, so why don't you 
get in the picture too?

I'll press the shutter, so why don't you 
get in the picture too?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, having a photographer and all. 
Fufufu, it feels somewhat like a 
graduation ceremony.

Afterwards, right up until the final 
cleanup deadline, I helped Aston Machan 
take photos with the plushies...

I returned to my room thinking that I 
should treasure the things I currently own 
as much as possible...
